capabilities.description: Vue SFC files route through WebCodex's native LSP surface.
Runner-owned MCP providers receive only explicit bounded non-secret environment mappings.
Provider lifecycle is observable and recoverable without hidden replay of the failed request.
A disposable worktree can rehearse upstream forward-porting without rewriting the real maintenance branch.
A signed local Desktop candidate can be built with source/toolchain provenance.
Desktop install and rollback are explicit, verified, backed up, and receipt-producing.
The pinned Vue/TypeScript toolchain can be inspected and explicitly repaired.
A slow optional context-bridge probe degrades instead of blocking the whole doctor.
When a context workspace is supplied, its machine-readable state must prove zero Codex model turns.
Native Codex is a behavior reference only: policy permits no Codex model fallback and a supplied bridge must prove zero model-turn usage.
Every tracked parity capability has a machine-readable WebCodex-native, zero-quota bridge, or fail-closed unavailable route.
A deterministic harness compares WebCodex evidence with a declared Codex behavior reference contract without running a Codex model turn.
